name: Custom Page Title
project_description: Custom Page Title lets a site administrator override the rendered page title on chosen paths without editing the underlying entity. A single admin settings form holds an ordered, weighted table of rules; each rule pairs one or more path patterns (Drupal path-matcher syntax, including aliases and wildcards) with a replacement title, an enabled flag, and (on multilingual sites) a set of languages the rule applies to. A hook_preprocess_page_title() implementation matches the current path against each enabled rule and swaps in the configured title. No dependencies beyond Drupal core; no permissions, services, entities, or Drush commands of its own.
